notes.title: 7 Girls War Trading Cards and More!
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1279270/7_Girls_War/][img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32398519/6ec3410575d0e4e0d48543dbeb5bd3133f8b0bca.png[/img][/url]
